text:
sofia: quick flag: onboarding sakura-v2-int8 shows locale glitches in staging smoke.

min: what glitches? small repro?

sofia: two: (1) JA polite/honorific prompts rephrased to informal tone (loss of keigo signals). (2) Mixed RTL/LTR lines sometimes flip parentheses and drop trailing punctuation.

harry: only on int8 runtime?

sofia: yes, fp32 and q4f look fine. repro points to int8 matmul-v3 + fused-softmax combo.

min: any token-id diffs or tokenization mismatches?

sofia: token counts are stable, but traces show occasional injected token id 0 between punctuation and adjacent token in mixed-direction lines.

rachel: example? paste short snippet

sofia: short traces:

```
fp32 ids: [5123, 14, 889, 4001]
int8 ids: [5123, 14, 0, 889, 4001]
```

sofia: arabic sample: fp32 -> "Use (API) now?" int8 -> ")API( now?"

harry: bracket flip likely from detok+bidi after the nul token. Root could be kernel pointer arithmetic or quantized sampling producing a near-eos 0.

devops-bot: staged deployment staging-int8-2026-03-22-173456 applied

min: short mitigation: add a detok sanitizer that removes null-like tokens before unicode-bidi runs; add two smoke checks to block int8 rollout: ja-keigo-preserve and ar-brackets-preserve.

sofia: opened ticket ML-1801 with minimal failing inputs and metrics. (link internal)

harry: i'll run asan+svmap on matmul-v3 with mixed-dir sequences and trace sampling path. ETA ~3h. If kernel issue confirmed, we'll rollback int8 matmul-v3 and gate on new smoke tests.

sofia: thanks — will keep thread updated. rachel will add the smoke cases to the onboard suite.

rachel: ack, adding tests and CI gate.

sofia: thanks all.
